title: Rav Acha of Karchina
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 33a, raising a difficulty against Rabbi Elazar, and Rabbi Elazar answered him. Hyman calls the Rav Ada reading in Sanhedrin 99a an error and says that it should read Rav Acha, as he reports in Dikdukei Soferim, for Rav Acha of Karchina was Rava’s student.

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot passage names Acha Karchina as the challenger. Hyman’s proposed Sanhedrin reading, his report of Dikdukei Soferim and his identification as Rava’s student remain his account.
